executor_result.summary: Group explicit economic_event_id observations by (family, metric, asset, economic_event_id) in suppress_duplicates, preserve economic_event_id in audit decisions, and add regression tests for distinct-asset event preservation and deterministic same-asset winner selection.

instructions: Small quality fix only. In suppress_duplicates, group explicit economic_event_id observations by (family, metric, asset, economic_event_id) rather than (family, metric, economic_event_id). Preserve the economic_event_id field in suppression audit decisions and deterministic same-asset winner selection. Add compact deterministic regression in test_contracts_normalization.py: BTC and ETH with identical family/metric/event id but different provider record ids both survive normalize_and_dedup with no suppression; same-asset cross-provider duplicate still resolves to one deterministic winner regardless of input order. No other behavior changes. Keep edits surgical; do not rewrite whole files. Run targeted and full Capital Flow pytest; fail closed on error.
title: Preserve distinct assets in economic-event duplicate suppression
